title: The person — Cynthia Udoh
description: Meet Cynthia Udoh, Lead Project Manager & Communications, working across creative delivery, team coordination, and the venture ecosystem.

section_01.text_005: I’m Cynthia Udoh, a project manager and communicator who enjoys making complex work feel manageable.
section_01.text_006: At Tony & Co, I manage projects and communications across brand, websites, video, motion and content. That has included work for a venture fund, a VC-led event and a founder community. I connect client decisions to the people delivering the work, so your team has a shared view of what happens next.
section_01.text_007: Find the overlap with your team ↗

section_01.text_011: CYNTHIA UDOH / ALWAYS CONNECTING THE DOTS

section_02.text_001: YOUR TEAM HAS THE TOOLS. THE WORK STILL NEEDS ALIGNMENT.
section_02.text_004: For VC teams, founders and the creative partners supporting them: a clear goal, connected contributors and follow-through at every stage.
section_02.text_008: Agree the brief, audience, deliverables and decisions before the work branches out.
section_02.text_013: Give designers, developers and content contributors clear owners, references and dependencies.
section_02.text_018: Bring feedback into one place, flag blockers and make the next action explicit.
section_02.text_023: Organize final files, receiving-team context and any remaining responsibilities.

section_03.text_005: Lead Project Manager & Communications · Tony & Co
section_03.text_006: I coordinate creative projects across brand, websites, video, motion, and content. My work spans client updates, internal priorities, feedback consolidation, project tracking, and handover preparation.
section_03.text_009: Community management and newsletter writing inform how I communicate: understand the audience, make the message useful, and give people a reason to stay engaged.
section_03.text_011: Open source. Venture. Better ways to work.
section_03.text_012: I’m interested in how communities and ambitious teams build together. I’m learning about the VC ecosystem and exploring where thoughtful project management and communications can make the biggest contribution.

section_04.text_002: “People do better work when they know where they’re going, what they own, and who has their back.”
section_04.text_003: A principle I bring to the way I manage projects.
